topic: Photograph a confusing knitting or crochet pattern and have AI ask which row you're stuck on, then explain it stitch by stitch
text:
A knitting or crochet pattern line like "k2tog, yo, sl1" can stop anyone cold. Tap the plus or paperclip in ChatGPT, add a photo of the page, and paste this:

This is my [knitting] pattern and I'm a beginner. Ask which row I'm stuck on, then explain it one stitch at a time in plain words.

For a tricky stitch, ask for the exact words to search on YouTube so you can watch it done.

What hobby have you been meaning to try?
